Osama bin Laden’s hard drives seized in Operation Neptune Spear contained shocking files that changed what the world thought about him. CIA findings showed future terror plots, secret letters, and plans to groom Hamza bin Laden as the next Al-Qaeda leader. At the same time, his computers stored movies, games like Counter-Strike, and even strange conspiracy books showing a life full of contradictions. This Video highlights how extremism grows, how propaganda works, and why questioning and critical thinking are the strongest weapons against blind hate.
